description:
The continuation of La Blue Girl.

Shin Injuu Gakuen adapts the end of the manga, and as such is a follow-up and the conclusion to Miko's adventures in the first series. This time the enemies are Fubuki Kai, a rogue ninja who wants to defeat Miko and claim the title of best ninja, and the cybernetized survivors of the Suzuka clan.

Note: The English release calls this Episodes 5-6 of the La Blue Girl series. The second episode originally released on VHS in 2 parts. Subsequent LaserDisc/DVD and English releases combine this into an hour-long episode.
